title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs
abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on highly non-linear components, in this work we demonstrate that they exhibit fundamental linearity: when inputs from distinct text streams are linearly combined, the model outputs a superposition of the individual next-token distributions. We term this the \textit{Superposition Linearity Hypothesis}. We provide evidence that superposition is an intrinsic property of the Transformer architecture rather than an emergent consequence of training; in fact, we observe that it tends to diminish as pretraining progresses. However, we demonstrate that linearity can be substantially restored through lightweight fine-tuning, significantly reducing the divergence between the predicted next-token distribution and the average of the individual next-token distributions. Finally, we introduce a guided decoding procedure that disentangles superposed outputs, enabling the simultaneous generation of two coherent continuations from a single forward pass.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our graduate course Transformer Architectures, today's lecture is on “Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs.” Recent work such as “How Do LLMs Use Their Depth?” and “Exploring the Hidden Capacity of LLMs for One-Step Text Generation” reflects growing interest in what models compute inside and how to use that computation efficiently. This paper asks whether ordinary Transformers can process two input streams together. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们研究生课程“Transformer架构”里，今天的讲座是“你的Transformer能同时容纳两个想法：大语言模型中线性叠加的证据”。最近的一些工作，比如“大语言模型如何利用它们的深度？”和“探索大语言模型在一步文本生成中的隐藏容量”，反映出大家越来越关注模型内部到底在计算什么，以及如何高效地利用这些计算。这篇论文问的是，普通Transformer能不能同时处理两路输入。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, does “together” mean the model receives both texts as one longer prompt?
segments.zh: 教授您好，“一起”是指模型把两段文本当成一个更长的提示词来接收吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not quite. The authors combine the token embeddings at corresponding positions by averaging them, then run that mixed sequence through an otherwise standard Transformer. They compare its output with the outputs from processing each text separately. The key question is whether both streams remain represented in the model’s predictions. This matters because efficient inference research often adds special machinery, while this paper tests whether pretrained models already have some capacity for multiplexing.
segments.zh: 不完全对。作者是把对应位置上的token嵌入做平均，然后把混合后的序列送进一个其他方面都标准的Transformer。他们把这个输出和处理两段文本各自的输出做比较。关键问题是，两路信息是否都还在模型的预测里有体现。这一点之所以重要，是因为高效推理研究往往会加一些专门的机制，而这篇论文要检验的是，预训练模型本身是不是已经具备某种多路复用的能力。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central idea is called the Superposition Linearity Hypothesis. If a model processes two independent streams approximately linearly, its output for their mixed embeddings should resemble a blend of the two separate output distributions. That does not mean the Transformer becomes wholly linear: attention and multilayer perceptrons remain nonlinear. Rather, the hypothesis concerns whether information from both inputs survives those operations well enough to influence the next-token predictions.
segments.zh: 核心想法叫叠加线性假说。如果一个模型对两条独立流的处理大致是线性的，那么它对混合嵌入的输出，就应该接近两个单独输出分布的混合。这并不意味着Transformer变成了完全线性的：注意力和多层感知机仍然是非线性的。更准确地说，这个假说关心的是，来自两个输入的信息在经过这些操作后，是否还能保留下来，足以影响下一个token的预测。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the authors are checking whether both streams’ likely next tokens remain visible, rather than expecting the mixed output to reproduce either stream exactly?
segments.zh: 所以作者是在检查两个流的可能下一个token是否都还能看见，而不是指望混合后的输出能精确复现其中任何一个流？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. Across Pythia, Qwen, Llama, OLMo, and Gemma models, the independently predicted next token for either stream often remains near the top of the mixed distribution. For unmodified models, each target token appears in the top 10 roughly 30% to 40% of the time, and in the top 100 roughly 60% to 65% of the time. Those rates substantially exceed a control based on token frequency alone.
segments.zh: 确实如此。在Pythia、Qwen、Llama、OLMo和Gemma这些模型上，任一数据流独立预测出的下一个token往往仍位于混合分布的前列。对于未经修改的模型，每个目标token出现在前10的概率大约在30%到40%之间，出现在前100的概率大约在60%到65%之间。这些比率大幅超过了仅基于token频率的对照组。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The evaluation looks beyond token ranks. The researchers compare the mixed output distribution with the arithmetic average of the two separate distributions, using measures such as K-L divergence and Jensen-Shannon divergence. They also test several context lengths. The mixed distribution is closer to the ideal blend than the two independent distributions are to each other, though it does not match perfectly. This gives a distribution-level view of how much information survives.
segments.zh: 评估不只看token排名。研究者把混合输出分布与两个独立分布的算术平均做比较，用了K-L散度和Jensen-Shannon散度这类指标。他们还测试了多种上下文长度。混合分布比两个独立分布彼此之间更接近理想混合，虽然并非完全吻合。这从分布层面展示了有多少信息得以保留。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: could common words alone explain why the separate predictions rank well in the mixed output?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：单独来看，常见词本身能不能解释为什么分开的预测在混合输出里排名也靠前？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is a legitimate concern, so the paper includes a frequency-only control: it checks how highly one stream’s target token ranks under an unrelated input. The control performs much worse. The authors also find that superposition is strongest near model initialization and declines during Pythia pretraining. That pattern suggests the capacity may be an architectural bias that language-model training partly erodes, rather than a skill standard pretraining deliberately teaches.
segments.zh: 这是个合理的担忧，所以论文加入了一个仅基于词频的对照实验：检查在无关输入下，某一个流的目标token排名有多高。这个对照的表现差得多。作者还发现，叠加效应在模型初始化附近最强，在Pythia预训练过程中逐渐减弱。这一模式说明，这种能力可能是一种架构偏差，语言模型训练会部分侵蚀它，而不是标准预训练有意教会的技能。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The attention experiments help locate what supports the effect. Randomly permuting attention weights sharply harms predictions, showing that natural attention structure matters. Replacing a text’s attention weights with weights from unrelated text can preserve some predictable words, but it fails on context-dependent content. On LAMBADA, donor patching performs far worse than ordinary embedding mixing. So the evidence points to a contribution from content-specific computation, not simply generic attention patterns.
segments.zh: 注意力实验有助于定位这种效应的支撑来源。随机打乱注意力权重会严重损害预测，说明自然的注意力结构很重要。把一段文本的注意力权重换成无关文本的权重，能保住一些可预测的词，但在依赖上下文的内容上就会失败。在 LAMBADA 上，供体替换的表现远不如普通的嵌入混合。所以证据指向的是内容特定计算的贡献，而不只是通用的注意力模式。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors also ask whether training can improve the blend. They use self-distillation: a student receives averaged embeddings and learns to match the average of two teacher distributions. This substantially improves agreement, especially for content tokens. But there is a trade-off: ordinary single-stream accuracy and FineWeb perplexity worsen. And preserving both signals in one distribution does not automatically produce two coherent continuations, because tokens favored by one stream may be suppressed by the other.
segments.zh: 作者还问训练能否改进这种混合。他们用了自蒸馏：学生模型接收平均后的嵌入，并学习去匹配两个教师分布的平均值。这大幅提升了一致性，尤其是对内容token。但存在权衡：普通单流准确率和FineWeb困惑度都会变差。而且把两种信号保留在同一个分布里，并不会自动产生两条连贯的续写，因为一条流偏好的token可能会被另一条流压制。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How do they separate the streams at generation time, and does that erase the efficiency benefit?
segments.zh: 他们在生成时是怎么把两路流分开的，这么做会不会把效率优势抵消掉？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They introduce Joint Contrastive decoding, combining a large model’s mixed-input output with predictions from a smaller auxiliary model that sees each stream separately. This improves LAMBADA accuracy for the mixed setup, but results remain below the single-stream baselines. The practical case is promising rather than settled: a fused two-head approach approaches batch-size-two throughput and can roughly double throughput over sequential processing, while auxiliary models add computation and memory.
segments.zh: 他们提出了联合对比解码，把大模型对混合输入的输出，和一个只看到各自独立流的较小辅助模型的预测结合起来。这提升了混合设置下的 LAMBADA 准确率，但结果仍低于单流基线。实际应用前景可期但尚未定论：融合双头方法接近批大小为二时的吞吐量，相比顺序处理大致能把吞吐量翻倍，而辅助模型会带来额外的计算和内存开销。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could this approach safely handle unrelated or private inputs in a shared inference system?
segments.zh: 这种方法能否在共享推理系统中安全处理无关或私密输入？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is an important systems question. The paper’s experiments focus on short, mostly monolingual text, and they do not establish reliable separation for private or sensitive inputs. Mixing streams could create unintended information interactions, so practical deployments would need explicit safeguards. Longer contexts, more than 2 streams, multilingual settings, and multimodal models also remain open tests. The results establish a measurable effect, not a general guarantee of independent processing.
segments.zh: 这是个重要的系统问题。论文的实验主要针对较短的、以单语为主的文本，并没有证明能对私密或敏感输入实现可靠分离。混合数据流可能造成意外的信息交互，因此实际部署需要明确的防护措施。更长的上下文、超过2路的数据流、多语言场景以及多模态模型，也都还有待检验。这些结果确立的是一种可测量的效应，而不是独立处理的普遍保证。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Conceptually, the work connects representation geometry with efficient generation: nonlinear Transformers can still preserve traces of multiple inputs. Its checkpoint results also raise a training question: if pretraining weakens this behavior, can objectives preserve it without sacrificing ordinary language modeling? That complements research on model depth and internal computation, while differing from engineered multiplexing methods that add dedicated encoding and separation components. Here, the starting point is a standard pretrained model and a simple embedding mixture.
segments.zh: 概念上，这项工作把表示几何和高效生成联系了起来：非线性Transformer依然能保留多个输入的痕迹。它的检查点结果也引出了一个训练层面的问题：如果预训练会削弱这种行为，那能不能设计出既保留它、又不牺牲普通语言建模能力的目标函数？这跟关于模型深度和内部计算的研究形成互补，但又有别于那些增加专门编码和分离组件的工程化多路复用方法。这里，起点是一个标准的预训练模型和一个简单的嵌入混合。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that a Transformer may hold two computational threads in one forward pass, but keeping both signals is not the same as decoding two clean answers. The paper measures that distinction, shows how training can strengthen superposition at a cost, and offers a partial decoding strategy. For researchers, the next challenge is to improve separation, efficiency, and safety together. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，Transformer 在一次前向传播中或许能同时承载两条计算线索，但把两个信号都保留下来，并不等于能解码出两个干净的答案。这篇论文衡量了这种区别，展示了训练如何以一定代价强化叠加，并提出了一种部分解码策略。对研究者来说，下一个挑战是同时提升分离度、效率与安全性。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
